notes.title: Slime Clicker is taking part in the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025!
1.1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Now you can select your preferred game difficulty
[*] Сursor: improved size and contrast for better visibility
[*] Slimes can now be popped with both left and right mouse buttons
[*] Various UI fixes and improvements
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese localization
[*] After finishing the timeline you will get 100 candies
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.0 demo update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug where clicks on slimes wouldn't work (the cause was clicking on a slime during a cutscene, which would break the game).
[*] New explosive birds!
[*] Improved balance: the game is now slightly easier for newcomers.
[*] Performance optimization.
[*] The mysterious merchant now flies to prevent accidental clicks on him.
[*] Localization bug fixes (dialogues didn't change the language before restarting the game).
[*] ACHIEVEMENTS
[/list]
